evidence.quote: if (existing.some((b) => b.isActive() && b.stay.overlaps(stay))) throw new Error(`Room ${roomId} is already booked`);

answer.rationale: The no-double-booking invariant (no overlapping active bookings per room) is decided in the application service by combining isActive() and stay.overlaps(). No aggregate owns it, since Booking is per-booking and there is no Room or schedule aggregate. The rule is a business invariant, not just a uniqueness check. The service lock only handles concurrency and does not move the rule into the domain.
